== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Surprise Assault (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Surprise Assault]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100710 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100710], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100710-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>b0ee80f1a89fb7e6e3a4335f5df5b470df4985b7f32d77190901ecffc249f79b</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
